title: We reached 100 wishlists on Steam for NeuralDefense!
author: SynapseGameStudios
selftext:
It might seem small to some, but it is huge to us. After several months of hard work, we are finally getting close to releasing the full version of the game.

Being such a small team of just four people, this whole journey has been a massive learning experience in game development. We’re genuinely thrilled by all the support we've received so far, every single wishlist keeps this project moving forward. Our big dream is to take everything we’re learning here and eventually build an exciting future project capable of reaching thousands of wishlists on Steam.

To be completely honest, the hardest part for us has been the marketing part, especially trying to reach players in other countries and regions, as algorithms constantly seem to keep us locked in a single area. Because of that, we are also still looking for a Community Manager to help us grow and connect with more players around the world.

If you want to support an indie dev team or check out what we've been building, the Steam link is in my bio. Thanks again for being part of this!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/SynapseGameStudios please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
